title: Protocol for establishing primary human lung organoid-derived air-liquid interface cultures from cryopreserved human lung tissue
protocol: Receive human lung tissue under clean/sterile conditions.
Cut the tissue into five sections from the apex to the lower part.
Cut each section into smaller pieces.
Name pieces from different areas of the lung: alveolar region as LA and bronchial region as LB.
Snap-freeze small pieces in OCT for histology or subject them to cryopreservation with 10% FBS and DMSO.
Transfer lung tissue to a sterile beaker containing media for tissue preservation (1× PBS supplemented with 50% FBS).
Add approximately 400–500 mL to cover the tissue.
Seal the beaker with sterile aluminum foil and parafilm.
Transfer the lung into a large sterile Pyrex container (24 cm × 36 cm × 6 cm).
Anatomically orientate the lung tissue based on its anatomical orientation.
Cut the lung tissue into slices approximately 4–5 cm thick, starting from the apex to the bottom part of the lung and then from distal to proximal.
Cut each slice into smaller pieces approximately 3 cm × 3 cm in size with a sterile scalpel.
Embed representative lung pieces (approximately 3 cm × 3 cm) in OCT.
Snap freeze the tissue blocks in liquid nitrogen.
Name each OCT tissue block based on anatomical region and donor code.
Mince the remaining tissue into smaller pieces, approximately 3 mm × 3 mm in size.
Place around 25 small tissue pieces into each cryovial (2 mL cryovial size).
Immediately add 1 mL of cold cryopreservation media (FBS 10% DMSO) to each cryovial.
Transfer the cryovials to an optimized freezing container.
Store the cryovials at −80°C for at least 24 hours before transferring them to liquid nitrogen for long-term storage.
Label each cryovial based on anatomical region, donor code, and date.
Prepare AdDF+ media for washing steps.
Prepare AO media for organoid generation.
Prepare media for tissue digestion containing 1-2 mg/mL of collagenase I.
Prepare media to stop tissue digestion reaction by supplementing 1× PBS with 2% FBS.
Thaw Cultrex growth factor reduced BME type 2 (Matrigel-like matrix) in the fridge 24 hours prior to use.
Place 2–3 cryovials into a dry bath at 37°C for 5 minutes to thaw tissue.
Transfer minced tissue into a 50 mL tube containing pre-warmed AdDF+ media (20-30 mL).
Centrifuge at 300g for 5 minutes (20°C–25°C) to remove DMSO.
Resuspend the minced tissue with 10 mL of pre-warmed media for tissue digestion.
Incubate on an orbital shaker at 37°C, 5% CO2 in a humidified atmosphere for 1 hour.
Shear the digested tissue between sterile slides.
Strain the digested tissue through a 100 μm filter using the piston of an insulin syringe to press the tissue through the filter.
Stop the digestion process by adding 1× PBS supplemented with 2% FBS (20°C–25°C).
Centrifuge at 300g for 5 minutes (20°C–25°C).
Resuspend the pellet in approximately 5 mL of 1× PBS (at 20°C–25°C).
Centrifuge the sample for 5 minutes at 300g (20°C–25°C) if a visible red pellet is present.
Proceed to erythrocyte lysis using 2 mL of red blood cell lysis buffer for 5 minutes at 20°C–25°C after centrifugation.
Add 10 mL of AdDF+ to stop the lysis process.
Strain the cells through a 100 μm filter using an insulin syringe piston.
Centrifuge the filtered sample at 300g for 5 minutes (20°C–25°C).
Resuspend the pellet in 1 ml of AO media pre-warmed to 37°C in a dry bath.
Count cells on a Malassez chamber by diluting approximately 10 μL of single cell suspension five times with 1× PBS.
Mix one volume of diluted cell suspension with one volume of trypan blue (0.4% in 1× PBS) to identify dead cells.
Apply approximately 10 μL of the cell mix to the counting chamber.
Count the cells within 3–5 minutes after mixing with trypan blue, focusing on the four corner squares plus the central large square.
Calculate total cell concentration using the formula: Total cells / ml = (number of cells × factor dilution × 10000 cells/ml) / 5.
Resuspend the lung cell suspension at 7.5 × 10^6 cells/mL final in a mix of ice-cold AO media and liquid Cultrex growth factor reduced BME type 2.
Mix the lung cell suspension.
Dispense approximately 300,000 cells/40 μL/well as a dome.
Incubate the plate in a humidified 37°C, 5% CO2 incubator at ambient O2 for 20 min to allow gellification.
Gently flip the plate right side up.
Add 400 μL of pre-warmed AO media (37°C in a dry bath).
Change media every day.
Remove media and add ice-cold 1× PBS.
Incubate the plate on ice for 30 min.
Pipette up/down to break the organoids.
Combine the organoids of all the wells in a 50 mL tube.
Centrifuge at 300g for 5 minutes (7°C).
For full organoid dissociation, add pre-warmed 1× TrypLE express.
Incubate 5 minutes at 20°C–25°C.
Mechanically dissociate the organoids by pipetting up and down.
Stop the reaction by adding ice-cold 1× PBS supplemented with 2% FBS.
Centrifuge at 300g for 5 minutes (7°C).
Monitor cell viability on chamber Malassez during dissociation.
If necessary, repeat steps from mechanical dissociation to stopping the reaction.
Resuspend cells in a mix of ice-cold AO media and liquid Cultrex growth factor reduced BME type 2.
Replate 300,000 cells/40 μL as a dome.
Repeat steps from adding TrypLE express to replate cells if necessary.
Count cells after each dissociation.
Cryopreserve at least 3–4 cryovials with 1.5 × 10^6 cells/mL/vial in FBS with 10% DMSO.
Generate a large frozen stock of dissociated organoids at 1.5 × 10^6 cells/cryovial after approximately 4–7 passages.
Perform a quality control check on domes containing spherical organoids free of connective tissue.
Typically, after 4–7 passages, expect high enrichment of lung epithelial progenitors.
Keep 10–20 μL of the organoid suspension.
Centrifuge at 300g for 5 min (4°C).
Resuspend the intact organoids in 20 μl of cold 1× PBS.
Transfer the organoid suspension on a Superfrost plus slide.
Incubate at 20°C–25°C for 10 min in a fume hood.
Fix and permeabilize organoids by applying 20 μL of −30°C acetone.
Gently rinse the organoids with 1× PBS.
Treat the organoids with Fc Receptor Block.
Wash the organoids three times with 1× PBS.
Treat the organoids with Background Buster treatment.
Repeat the wash step with 1× PBS.
Prepare a mix of primary antibodies in staining buffer.
Incubate the mix of primary antibodies in the dark.
Repeat the wash step with 1× PBS.
Prepare a mix of secondary antibodies in staining buffer.
Incubate the mix of secondary antibodies in the dark.
Repeat the wash step with 1× PBS.
Counterstain sections with 1 μg/mL final concentration of 4',6-diamidino-2-phenylindole (DAPI) in 1× PBS for 5 minutes at 20°C–25°C.
Wash the stained sections.
Mount whole mount organoids on slides using Fluoromount-G and cover with glass coverslips.
Acquire images using a confocal microscope, such as Leica SP8.
Analyze images using software like Imaris.
Expand cells in submerged culture to obtain confluence at 100%.
Differentiate cells in submerged cultures to foster tight junctions and barrier integrity, monitored by TEER values (>500 Ω cm²).
Remove apical media when TEER goals are achieved to initiate final differentiation into pseudo-stratified epithelia.
Monitor cultures for a minimum of 4 weeks for the presence of beating cilia and mucus production.
Pre-coat Transwells apically with Collagen I at a concentration of 30 μg/mL for 1 hour at 37°C.
Rinse the wells with 1× PBS.
Submerge the inserts in 1× PBS at 37°C until cell seeding.
Thaw lung organoid-derived cell suspension by placing it into a dry bath at 37°C for 5 minutes.
Transfer cells into a conical tube containing fresh pre-warmed ALI Expansion media.
Centrifuge the cell suspension at 300g for 5 minutes at 20-25°C.
Resuspend the cells in ALI Expansion media to achieve a final concentration of 300,000 cells/mL.
Plate the cells (30,000 cells/100 μL/well).
Use complete ALI expansion media supplemented with Y-27632 until reaching 100% confluence.
Change the media daily on both apical and basal sides during the expansion step.
Switch to complete ALI differentiation and maintenance media supplemented with Y-27632 after reaching 100% confluence.
Change the media daily on both apical and basal sides during the differentiation step.
Perform TEER measurements using the EVOM2 ohm meter during days 13–19 after every media change (3 times per week).
Remove media from the apical side of ALI cultures for airlift differentiation.
Maintain media supply on the basal side at 500 μl/well.
Change the media on the basal side 3 times per week.
Check ALI cultures under a bright-field microscope for beating cilia and mucus production.
Remove mucus by applying pre-warmed 1× PBS apically.
Incubate at 37°C for 15 minutes in a humidified atmosphere with 5% CO2.
Gently pipette up and down to remove the mucus.
Repeat steps (a-c) until mucus is eliminated.
Change basal media.
Apply 105 PFU virus apically, typically using 25-100 μL at day 0 (D0).
Incubate mock inserts with infection medium containing no virus for control conditions.
Harvest inserts every day from 1 to 6 post-infection for analysis.
Turn the insert upside-down.
Cut the mesh in the middle and partially around the edges with a scalpel.
Place the ALI mesh on top of a layer of OCT.
Cover the ALI mesh with OCT to fully embed the ALI insert.
Use a pipette tip gently to ensure the ALI is not curved or too close to the bottom or surface of the cryomold.
Snap freeze the cryomold in liquid nitrogen.
Make a mark with a Sharpie pen on the cryomold to indicate the location of the ALI culture.
Repeat the marking process on the solidified OCT block.
Trim the OCT until the mark is reached to visualize the ALI culture.
Transfer ALI culture sections into Superfrost plus slides.
Add 150 μL of pre-warmed 1× PBS to the apical side of each ALI culture.
Incubate in a humidified 37°C, 5% CO2 incubator at ambient O₂ for 15 min.
Collect supernatants by pipetting up and down.
Store the collected supernatants at -80°C in a BSL3 facility.
Serially dilute each apical supernatant from infected and non-infected ALI cultures in 1× PBS containing 1% BSA.
Overlay each dilution per condition on pre-seeded confluent VeroE6 cell or Vero-E6 TMPRSS2 monolayers.
Incubate at 37°C for 1 hour with gentle shaking every 5 minutes.
Infect each well with 200 μL of diluted samples in a 12-well plate.
Overlay a solution containing 2% Oxoid agarose mixed with 2× MEM supplemented with 0.3% FBS on the monolayers.
Incubate for 72 hours at 37°C.
Fix with 4% formaldehyde solution (100 μL apically and 500 μL basally) for at least 12 hours at 20°C–25°C.
Wash with 1× PBS, three times for 5 minutes each at 20°C–25°C.
Incubate with SARS-CoV-2 NP antibody (1C7C7, 1/250) primary antibody for 1.5 hours at 20°C–25°C with gentle shaking.
Wash with 1× PBS, three times for 5 minutes each at 20°C–25°C.
Incubate with an HRP-conjugated secondary anti-mouse antibody (1/5000) for 1 hour at 20°C–25°C with gentle shaking.
Wash with 1× PBS, three times for 5 minutes each at 20°C–25°C.
Reveal plaques using TrueBlue peroxidase substrate (250 μL for a P12-well plate) for around 10 minutes.
Calculate titers as plaque-forming units per mL (PFU/mL) for every sample: plaques * dilution * volume = PFU/mL
Wash ALI cultures with 1× PBS (150 μL apically and 500 μL basally).
Treat with 0.05% trypsin on the apical chamber (150 μL) and basal chamber (500 μL) for 15 min at 37°C.
Pipette up/down to dissociate the ALI tissue.
Transfer the cell suspension into a 15 mL tube.
Neutralize trypsin with an equal volume of 1× PBS containing 2% FBS (650 μL, at 20°C–25°C).
Centrifuge at 300g for 5 min (20°C–25°C).
Resuspend cells in a dispase I/DNase I solution (3 mL).
Incubate the resuspended cells in a dry bath for 10–15 min at 37°C.
Centrifuge at 300g for 5 min (at 25°C–28°C).
Resuspend cells in 1× PBS and stain with zombie live dead stain according to manufacturer protocol, at 1/350 dilution for approximately 3 × 10^6 cells for 15 min at 25°C–28°C.
Centrifuge at 300g for 5 min (at 25°C–28°C).
Resuspend the cells in 4% methanol-free formaldehyde (100 μL/condition).
Fix over at least 12 h at 4°C.
Add 1 mL of 1× perm wash buffer per tube containing fixed cells.
Centrifuge at 300g for 5 min (at 25°C–28°C).

Resuspend the pellet in 100 μL perm wash buffer with conjugated SARS-CoV-2 N antibody (1C7C7) at a final dilution of 1/100 or 1 μg/mL for Alexa Fluor 488-conjugated, or 1/200 or 1 μg/mL for Alexa Fluor 647-conjugated.
Incubate in the dark at 25°C–28°C for 45 min.
Add 1 mL perm wash buffer.
Centrifuge samples at 300g for 5 minutes.
Resuspend the pellet in 200 mL of a 1% BSA solution in 1× PBS.
Analyze by flow cytometry for live SARS-CoV-2 NP positive cells.
Fix ALI cultures using 4% PFA diluted in 1× PBS for 15 minutes at 4°C.
Wash the fixed cultures with 1× PBS.
Maintain the washed cultures in 1× PBS at 4°C until further processing.
Cut the ALI mesh in half using a sterile scalpel for each condition.
Embed the samples in OCT between 25°C and 28°C.
Snap freeze the embedded samples in liquid nitrogen.
Store the OCT blocks at -80°C for several months if needed.
Cut frozen sections to a thickness of 8 μm.
Air dry the frozen sections on Superfrost plus slides.
Use a hydrophobic pen to create a barrier around the tissue sections.
Fix the sections with 4% PFA for 15 minutes between 25°C and 28°C.
Wash the fixed tissue sections three times with 1× PBS, each for 5 minutes.
Permeabilize the sections with 1× PBS/0.1% Triton X-100 for 15 minutes at 25°C–28°C.
Repeat the wash step with 1× PBS.
Treat sections with Fc Receptor Block for 45 minutes at 25°C–28°C.
Repeat the wash step with 1× PBS.
Treat sections with Background Buster for 30 minutes at 25°C–28°C.
Repeat the wash step above in (i).
Stain first with unconjugated antibodies for 1 hour at 25°C–28°C.
Repeat the wash step above in (i).
Apply secondary antibodies for 30 minutes at 25°C–28°C.
Repeat the wash step above in (i).
Add mouse serum to saturate secondary antibodies, diluted 1/20 in staining buffer.
Incubate for 15 minutes at 25°C–28°C.
Repeat the wash step above in (i).
Continue the staining with directly conjugated antibody mix for 1 hour at 25°C–28°C.
Repeat the wash step above in (i).
Stain for actin filaments with Phalloidin ATTO647N for 15 minutes at 25°C–28°C.
Counterstain sections with DAPI for 5 minutes at 25°C–28°C.
Repeat the wash step above in (i).
Mount ALI slides with Fluoromount-G and cover glass.
Dissociate ALI as described in steps (9.a.) to (9j.).
Wash dissociated ALI cell suspension by centrifugation (300g, 5 min, at 25°C–28°C).
Isolate total RNA using Direct-zol RNA MicroPrep kits.
Perform a DNase treatment using the RNase-free DNase set.
Prepare cDNA libraries using polyA mRNA selection and Kapa Stranded mRNA-seq Library Prep kit.
Perform paired-end sequencing of stranded total RNA libraries using Illumina NovaSeq or similar.
Use FastQC for quality control.
Remove rRNA contamination with MultiQC.
Trim reads with BBDuk tool.
Map viral reads to the FDA-ARGOS SARS-CoV-2 reference sequences.
Map human reads to GRCh38 genome using bowtie2.
Quantify gene expression using RSEM.
Apply batch correction using R package SVAseq.
Use DESeq2 for read normalization and differential gene expression.
Cut 6 μm thick sections from ALI culture-OCT blocks and air dry on Superfrost plus slides.
Store the slides in a secured −80°C freezer until use.
Prepare PFA (4% in 1× PBS) fixed-frozen tissue slides.
Load slides into the slide holder of the GeoMx digital spatial profiling (DSP) instrument.
Cover each slide with 2 mL of manufacturer buffer S.
Stain slides with Syto83 for nuclei staining (Cy3/568 nm).
Stain slides with Cytokeratin 5 (CK5) antibody (FITC/525 nm).
Stain slides with SARS-CoV-2 Spike antibody (Texas Red/615 nm).
Stain slides with SARS-CoV-2 Nucleocapsid antibody (Cy5/666 nm).
Select regions of interest based on the staining patterns.
Expose selected ROIs to UV photocleavable barcode RNA probes.
Process samples according to the manufacturer’s DSP and PCR protocol.
Sequence purified libraries using an Illumina NovaSeq 6000 or similar machine.
Perform GeoMX data processing according to NanoString protocols.
Conduct data analysis in R (v4.2.0).
Produce graphics using ggplot2 unless otherwise stated (v3.3.6).
Identify differentially expressed genes using a Wilcoxon rank-sum test.
Adjust p values using Benjamini-Hochberg multiple testing correction.
Use a p value cut-off of 0.05 and logFC of 2 for DEGs identification.
Analyze gene variability across the whole dataset by Kruskal-Wallis test (p < 0.05).
Generate heatmaps to show clustering of different ROI groups using ComplexHeatmap package (v2.12.1).
